request.system:
You extract project issues from documents about building grid-scale battery storage sites.
Return JSON that matches the schema exactly.

Definitions and rules:
- An issue is a risk, problem, delay, unanswered dependency, constraint or past incident that affects or could affect programme, cost or handover. Work that is simply complete is not an issue.
- Return one mention per distinct issue in this document. Do not merge unrelated issues. Do not split one issue into several.
- title: at most 10 words, neutral wording, no project name.
- description: one or two plain sentences.
- counterparty_role: who the issue depends on or was caused by. Use one of: DNO, civils contractor, contractor, transformer supplier, LPA, landowner, internal. Use null if none is clear.
- status: open = unresolved as of this document; resolved = the document says it is done or closed; materialised = it has now caused a programme slip or a confirmed adverse date; occurred = a past incident described for the record or as a lesson.
- awaiting_third_party: true if the team is waiting on a response or deliverable from someone outside the project team.
- chase_count: the number of chases or requests the document states for this issue, otherwise null.
- programme_impact: realised if a slip has happened, potential if the document says it could affect the programme, otherwise none_stated.
- triggers: only when the document states a condition or deadline after which the issue becomes critical or the programme is at risk. condition_text must be copied from the document. Resolve deadline_date to yyyy-mm-dd using the document date 2025-07-04: a month name means the last day of that month; "within N weeks" means the document date plus N weeks; "autumn" means 1 September of that year. If it cannot be resolved, use null.
- evidence_quote: copy an exact, contiguous piece of the document text, at most 200 characters, that supports the mention. Do not paraphrase.
- programme: fill only values the document states. Dates as yyyy-mm-dd. Use null otherwise.
request.user:
Document date: 2025-07-04
Project: ashfield
Document type: weekly_report

---
Ashfield weekly - week ending 04/07/2025

PM: J. Patel

PROGRAMME
Baseline energisation 14/11/2025
Current forecast 28/11/2025 - FORECAST SLIPPED 14 DAYS
Float: zero, now in delay

PROGRESS
Mechanical and electrical installation complete. Site is
effectively ready for energisation.

ISSUES
DNO have now confirmed the connection works date: 10/11/2025.
This leaves no contingency before the 14/11 energisation date and
the works themselves are quoted at 5-10 working days.

This has been flagged in weekly reports since March. The date was
never confirmed and we did not escalate it formally. In hindsight
we should have, in week 12.

Commercial implication: we have a capacity market agreement with
a delivery start of 01/12/2025. A 14 day slip takes us to 28/11,
which is inside the window but with nothing spare. Any further
slip and we are exposed.

ACTIONS
- Formal escalation to DNO account manager (done 03/07)
- Reviewing whether any commissioning activity can be brought
  forward

---
